rubrics.criterion: On first load, the white bradyperron loader reports real local-image preload progress, then reveals a centered media stack whose temporary cards fan offscreen while the same persistent four desktop or three mobile cards disperse directly into their moving grid paths without a visual reset.

The default grid continuously recycles four project media cards on desktop and three on mobile across varied horizontal, vertical, and diagonal paths; available local preview loops autoplay silently, wheel and pointer-drag input change velocity, and selecting a card opens that project.

The fixed list control crossfades to a looping 17-title list with the centered title enlarged and widely tracked while matching project media forms a depth-scaled ring below; wheel and drag input move both systems together and the active local preview loop plays when available.

Selecting a project opens an accessible fullscreen modal with a local autoplay preview when available or a poster fallback, a more-info scroll action, exact metadata, an external watch-film link when available, close controls, Escape handling, focus trapping, and focus restoration.

The fixed bradyperron, list/grid, and about controls use the locally hosted Fraunces Thin face, and the about action opens a slide-up accessible panel with staggered manifesto text, portrait reveal and drift, contact links, responsive layout, and reduced-motion behavior.
